lines: They broke on my hurdles and your bow. That's the first night held.
The library's bell used to warn the whole valley. There's a mark by the library door: put the bell back in its cupola, and we'll hear the next lot coming.
My hurdles are ready for the halt road, wherever you want them on the pads. They'll hold a while. The rest is your bow.
Ring when you're ready, not before.
Their camp's still out on the halt road. I can see their eyes from the stall at dusk.
Hale's hurdles are ready whenever you are.
entries.why: priority 11 outranks Moss's act-1 lines (10), but only while the raid is put off and no quest of hers can start or run: her three act-1 quests start on talking to her and each needs the Frostline built first (Bread for the Col hut asks for zone_built:frostline; the choked well follows the bread, the landslip the wolf moon), so this line never shows while the Frostline is in the build
